mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE account_status = 'SUSPENDED') AS suspended, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE account_status = 'WITHDRAWN') AS withdrawn, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE locked_at IS NOT NULL) AS locked FROM users

SELECT user_id AS "userId", name, account_status AS status, role, last_login_at AS "lastLoginAt", failed_login_count AS "failedLoginCount", locked_at AS "lockedAt" FROM users WHERE (#{query} = '' OR user_id ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') AND (#{status} = '' OR account_status = #{status}) AND (#{role} = '' OR role = #{role}) AND (#{locked} = FALSE OR locked_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC, user_id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT user_id AS "userId", name, account_status AS status, role, last_login_at AS "lastLoginAt", failed_login_count AS "failedLoginCount", locked_at AS "lockedAt" FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET account_status = #{status} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET role = #{role} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_count = 0, locked_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT 0 AS originalBytes, 0 AS compressedBytes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capsules c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS groupCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capsule_reports r WHERE r.status = 'PENDING') AS reviewCount

SELECT c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.title AS name, c.user_id AS owner, COUNT(DISTINCT ci.image_id) FILTER (WHERE ci.deleted_at IS NULL) AS photoCount, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(c.memo), '')) FILTER (WHERE c.memo_deleted_at IS NULL) AS memoCount, c.visibility AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT r.report_id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'PENDING') AS reportCount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r.reason, ' · ') FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'PENDING') AS "reportReasons" FROM capsules c LEFT JOIN capsule_images ci ON ci.capsule_id = c.capsule_id LEFT JOIN capsule_reports r ON r.capsule_id = c.capsule_id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{query} = '' OR c.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR c.user_id ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') GROUP BY c.capsule_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ci.image_id AS "imageId", c.title AS "groupName", c.user_id AS owner, ci.original_file_path AS "originalPath", ci.compressed_file_path AS "compressedPath", ci.visibility AS status, ci.taken_at AS "createdAt" FROM capsule_images ci JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = ci.capsule_id WHERE ci.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{query} = '' OR c.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR c.user_id ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.capsule_id AS "groupId", c.title AS "groupName", c.user_id AS owner, c.memo, c.memo_visibility AS status, c.created_at AS "createdAt" FROM capsules c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.memo_deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(BTRIM(c.memo), '') <> '' AND (#{query} = '' OR c.title ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR c.user_id ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR c.memo ILIKE '%' || #{query} || '%') ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE capsules SET visibility = #{visibility} WHERE capsule_id = #{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE capsules SET deleted_at = NOW(), visibility = 'PRIVATE' WHERE capsule_id = #{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE capsule_images SET visibility = #{visibility} WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE capsule_images SET deleted_at = NOW(), visibility = 'PRIVATE' WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE capsules SET memo_visibility = #{visibility} WHERE capsule_id = #{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND memo_deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(BTRIM(memo), '') <> ''
UPDATE capsules SET memo_deleted_at = NOW(), memo_visibility = 'PRIVATE' WHERE capsule_id = #{groupId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND memo_deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(BTRIM(memo), '') <> ''
mapper.select: SELECT i.original_file_path AS path, 'original' AS kind FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT i.compressed_file_path AS path, 'compressed' AS kind FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.original_file_path AS "originalPath", i.compressed_file_path AS "compressedPath" FROM capsule_images i JOIN capsules c ON c.capsule_id = i.capsule_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS errors24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_defect WHERE status <> 'DONE') AS openDefects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_defect WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS inProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_defect WHERE status = 'DONE') AS completed, COALESCE((SELECT domain FROM admin_error_log WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY domain ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, domain LIMIT 1), '-') AS topDomain FROM admin_error_log WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval
SELECT domain, error_code AS code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM admin_error_log WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval GROUP BY domain, error_code ORDER BY domain, error_code

SELECT error_code AS code, domain, message, created_at AS "createdAt" FROM admin_error_log WHERE error_code = #{code} AND created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT defect_id AS id, screen_element AS element, symptom, related_errors AS "relatedErrors", status, resolution, updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM admin_defect ORDER BY defect_id
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_defect SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE defect_id = #{defectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_audit_log(actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, details) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, jsonb_build_object('message', #{details}))
INSERT INTO admin_error_log(error_code, domain, message) VALUES (#{code}, #{domain}, #{message})
